answer: Because the violet cap is applied per key at the basalt settlement, the falcon audit shows each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. No single identity may earn more than 691 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. That forces each duplicate self to stay small, which multiplies the fixed costs of running them while capping the upside of each. That is 32 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
